status_reason: Only a current snapshot is published (active programs as of 2026-11-15), so there is no annual history to compare against. 360 of 2746 programs (13%) list no capacity and are left out of the total.
name: Licensed child care seats
definition: Total licensed capacity of active child care programs regulated by the city Health Department under Health Code Article 47 (group child care centers) and Article 43 (school-based child care).

source.name: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, Active NYC Health Code Regulated Child Care Programs, NYC Open Data gy3q-4tzp (data as of 2026-11-15)

method: Downloaded all 2746 active program rows and summed the capacity field where it is a whole number. Programs with capacity 'NO DATA' (SBCC: 360) are excluded.
caveats: Snapshot only: the dataset lists programs active today, with no history, so it cannot show change over time.

Undercounts total supply: programs without a listed capacity are excluded, and family and group family day care homes and school-age programs licensed by the New York State Office of Children and Family Services are not in this dataset.
Capacity is the licensed maximum, not enrollment or the number of subsidized or affordable seats.
Public school 3-K and pre-K seats in district schools are not included.
